title: Validate DaoManager resource and clock configuration exactly
description: python/src/lichen/rpl/dao_manager.py __post_init__ only compares capacities and timing values numerically. bools, floats, infinities, and NaN can pass: for example max_targets=float('nan') disables len > max_targets enforcement, and NaN lifetime_unit_seconds/freshness_retention_seconds or clock results create invalid deadlines that never expire. Validate all capacities as exact positive bounded ints, pcs/rpl IDs/sequences as exact bounded ints, timing configuration and every clock/now_seconds sample as finite non-negative values with the required monotonic policy before replay-floor persistence or route mutation. Add bool/float/NaN/infinity/huge-bound and failing-clock tests.
